newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Shougang H1 post-tax profit rises 60.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: China's Shougang H1 post-tax profit rises 60.9 pct.

text.p: The post-tax profit of China's Capital Iron and Steel Group, or Shougang, rose a year-on-year 60.93 percent in the first half of 1997 to hit 153 million yuan ($18.43 million), a company official said on Friday.
Shougang Group's sales hit 11.6 billion yuan in the first half, up 7.15 percent compared with the year-ago period, the official said by telephone.
Profits of the group's main subsidiary had reached 413 million yuan in the period but losses in other operations had cut into the group's total profits, the official said.
The sales-to-production ratio reached 100.2 percent, he said but gave no comparative figures and declined to give further details.
The Shougang Group has said it made a pre-tax profit of 324 million yuan in 1996.
